Name: rBeltSpd
Comment: Belt speed for tracked moves [mm/s] (fallback diagnostics)

Name: stTargetBelt
Comment: Target of the armed move in the BELT CS/PCS [mm, rad]

Name: stBeltOrg
Comment: Belt CS origin in MCS, x-axis along belt travel

Name: stObjBelt
Comment: Product pose in the belt CS at capture (session anchor)

Name: bTrkReq
Comment: TRUE = the armed TrackAbs move runs native tracked (policy: GVL_SP_Fw.g_eTrkMode AND feed wired, by SP_Robot)

Name: uiErrId
Comment: Error id (1 robot layer, 201/202 tracking session)

Name: bTrkSess
Comment: FW-1: tracking session open or releasing

Name: bTrkInSync
Comment: FW-1: group synchronized with the belt (Active)

Name: ioBelt
Comment: FW-1: conveyor belt encoder axis (per pick feed)

Name: m_fbEn
Comment: CONFIRM: PLCopen Part 4 group FB instances

Name: m_fbStop
Comment: PLCopen Part 4 group stop instance (firmware adapter)

Name: m_fbLin
Comment: Linear move instance (static MCS AND synchronized PCS moves)

Name: m_fbTrk
Comment: FW-1: PLCopen Part 4 conveyor tracking instance (session transform)

Name: m_fbTrkTo
Comment: Session start watchdog (Active must come within 2 s)

Name: m_bMvExec
Comment: Held Execute for the active move

Name: m_bTrkSess
Comment: Session open (tracking requested and not yet released)

Name: m_bTrkExec
Comment: Held Execute of m_fbTrk (TRUE for the whole session)

Name: m_bTrkRel
Comment: Release pending: waiting for Active = FALSE

Name: m_bTrkArm
Comment: Tracked move armed, waiting for Active before firing

Name: m_bTrkDrop
Comment: TRUE = drop the session when the closing MCS move finishes

Name: m_arrCbOrg
Comment: CONFIRM: PLCopen ConveyorBeltOrigin array (X, Y, Z, Theta)

Name: m_arrObjIni
Comment: CONFIRM: PLCopen InitialObjectPosition array (X, Y, Z, Theta)

Name: m_rDtSec
Comment: Task period [s] for the simulation integrator
